correctness.rationale: The mixed vertices are exactly the endpoints of the cut. On a tree, an edge set fixes the binary coloring once one root bit is given. Thus an edge cover contributes exactly two colorings to the central fiber. In a different realized fiber at least one outside bit is fixed, the cut is contained in the induced mixed forest, and adjoining all edges outside that induced forest gives an injective completion of degree shift h_Q. This includes the empty mixed set, and h_Q is positive because the tree has no isolated vertices. Substituting z=1 proves the strict gap and the uniform-output entropy formula. The two-state recurrence follows by excluding the configuration in which no child edge is selected, and the complexity is arithmetic, not bit complexity. A separate bounded enumeration of closed neighborhoods, cuts and covers confirmed the two polynomial assertions for 145 labeled trees of orders 2–5 and all 3,275 realized fibers.
residual_risks: The bounded computation does not independently reproduce the frozen verifier's complete test suite or prove the general theorem.

originality.rationale: A distinct indexed isolate-free forest result covers the submitted tree claim. Its parity-constrained formula gives the admissible cuts and their exact multiplicities, not merely the value of a peak count. Weight each admissible cut F by z^|F| and restrict to one tree component. In its fixed-completion proof, the chosen incident-edge set may be enlarged to all edges outside the induced mixed forest without changing injectivity. This gives exactly the submitted h_Q and coefficient bound. The broader result also gives the same edge-cover recurrence. No separate scientific remainder is established by making the coefficientwise grading explicit. This is a comparison of available statements, not a claim that the later-dated record preceded the frozen work or an attribution of authorship.
residual_risks: Published priority and the relationship between the two records are not determined by their dates or this review.
The inaccessible edge-cover and covering-based texts were not ruled out as further antecedents.

value.rationale: The theorem addresses a natural information-loss question: it locates the unique most ambiguous observation and computes the exact worst-case output probability at every tree order. The degree-shifting injection exposes why the gap holds and provides a useful certificate stronger than counts alone. This assessment concerns the mathematical question and result, not distinctness from the wider indexed result.
residual_risks: No equivalent unrestricted edge-cover count on graphs with cycles; no bit-complexity claim.
